# Verification & hardening of incident recovery

## Goal

Verify all recovery acceptance criteria for SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ are met and harden the local git state so the destructive commit `2c30dbfe` is fully purged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC1 — Local `dev` branch restored to full repository tree: verified by `git rev-parse HEAD` pointing at a valid commit on `origin/dev` and `git status` clean (unrelated other-agent working-tree modifications excepted and recorded).
- Parent AC2 — Destructive commit `2c30dbfe` unreachable from any local branch: verified by `git for-each-ref --contains 2c30dbfe` returning empty across all branches and worktrees.
- Parent AC3 — Test-isolation guard added to `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo`: the fixture asserts `tmp_path` is not inside a git repository before executing `git init`, and a regression test `test_init_repo_refuses_live_repo_tmp_path` verifies this guard.
- Flake-free verification — reflog entries referencing `2c30dbfe` are expired (`git reflog expire --expire=now --all`) and the object pruned (`git gc --prune=now`), so `git cat-file -t 2c30dbfe` reports the object no longer exists.
- Audit suite green — `pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings skill/audit/` passes, confirming the guard changes introduce no regressions in the affected suite.
- Evidence recorded — the output of every verification command above is captured in a comment on this work item.
## Constraints

- Do not disturb other agents' worktrees or branches.
- Only the main checkout's git state may be touched.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — fixture guard + regression test.
data.title: Verify & harden incident recovery

# Full project test suite verification

## Goal

Run the full project test suite to confirm the test-isolation guard changes (delivered via SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42) introduce no regressions, satisfying AC4 of SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC4 — Full project test suite passes with the new changes (pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings from repo root).
- Any failures are triaged: pre-existing or unrelated failures are reported and tracked in existing work items, and are not caused by the guard changes.
- A summary of test counts and any triaged failures is recorded in a comment on this work item.
## Constraints

- No changes beyond the guard already delivered; this is a verification item.
- If the guard caused a failure, stop and report — do not modify the fixture without a separate work item.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — the changed fixture and regression test.

data.comment:
Documentation completeness audit summary (parent AC5):

**Checked:**
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — the only file in the repo referencing the incident (`grep -rn "2c30dbfe|SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42|472 files"` returns only this file).
- `README.md` and `docs/` — no entry documents the git-init incident. The `test-isolation` mentions in `docs/dev/ship-skill-reference.md`, `docs/dev/release-process.md` and `skill/ship/SKILL.md` cover a **different** incident (SA-0MSJ2XMQL006CVQS — spuriously closed work items), so no changes were needed there.
- `CHANGELOG.md` is out of scope (managed by the ship release pipeline).

**Updated:**
- Class docstring: corrected the guard description from "tmp_path is not a git repo root" to "tmp_path is not inside any git repository — neither the repository root itself nor any path nested within a checkout", matching the hardened implementation.
- `_init_repo` docstring: now explains the practical git-operation surface (`git init`, `git add -A`, `git commit`) and why the guard must reject any nested `tmp_path`, not merely the repo root; still references SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42.
- Regression docstring `test_init_repo_refuses_live_repo_tmp_path`: descriptive (incident, commit context, both rejected cases) — verified present.

**Verification:** `pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` → 25 passed.
